test_results.details: Testing row with orderQty ≤ available stock should import without warning
test_results.actual: ✅ calculateAvailableStock returns available > orderQty; hasWarning=false; row added to okStockRows

test_results.details: Testing row with orderQty > available stock without acknowledgment should fail
test_results.actual: ✅ validateRowStockWarning returns hasWarning=true; createPlan checks !item.stockWarningAcknowledged and returns STOCK_WARNING_REQUIRED error; frontend prevents submit if unacknowledgedWarnings.length > 0

test_results.scenario: (c) Stock warning with acknowledge (imports with flag)
test_results.details: Testing row with orderQty > available stock + acknowledgment should import with metadata
test_results.actual: ✅ When item.stockWarningAcknowledged=true and warning.hasWarning=true, metadata is set: stockWarningAcknowledged=true, acknowledgedAt=now, stockWarningDetails=warning object. Row is inserted with these fields.

test_results.details: Testing edit that increases orderQty beyond available stock should show warning
test_results.expected: ⚠️ Warning shown only on qty increase
test_results.actual: ✅ editPlan line 1456 checks: if (req.body.orderQty && req.body.orderQty > (existingPlan.orderQty || 0)); only then calls validateRowStockWarning. If hasWarning and !acknowledged, returns error.

test_results.details: Testing edit that decreases orderQty should not show warning
test_results.actual: ✅ Stock warning validation only runs if newQty > oldQty. If decreased or unchanged, condition fails and validation is skipped entirely.

test_results.scenario: (f) Excel import with mixed rows (both OK and warning)
test_results.details: Testing Excel with mixed stock warning rows should allow selective override
test_results.expected: ✅ Show both OK and warning rows, allow override
test_results.actual: ✅ previewImportExcel creates d.okStockRows and d.warningStockRows arrays (lines 2710-2740); commitImportExcel checks stockWarningOverrides map and skips rows not overridden (line 2821); only imports rows with explicit override flag

test_results.details: Testing Import Previous Day with stock warnings should show preview with override option
test_results.expected: ✅ Show preview with warning, allow override before import
test_results.actual: ✅ importPreviousDay calculates stockWarnings array after filtering completed rows (lines 1375-1410); returns hasStockWarnings flag and stockWarnings array in response; allows user to proceed with override

test_results.details: Testing that available stock is recalculated based on current allocations
test_results.actual: ✅ calculateAvailableStock queries LacquerPlan allocations in real-time using $expr with completion check; Incoming Plan allocations; called on every validation (preview, create, edit, import). No caching - always fresh calculation.

test_results.scenario: (i) Completed rows don't affect available stock
test_results.details: Testing that completed rows are excluded from allocation calculation
test_results.expected: ✅ Completed rows not counted in allocation
test_results.actual: ✅ calculateAvailableStock query includes: $expr { $lt: ['$coatingCompletedQty', '$orderQty'] } which EXCLUDES completed rows (coatingCompletedQty >= orderQty). Properly handles both fields: coatingCompletedQty and deprecated coatedQty

calculateAvailableStock.details: Function properly calculates: 1) totalStock from PlainBottleStock.availableQuantity 2) sums LacquerPlan allocations (incomplete only: coatingCompletedQty < orderQty) from TODAY onwards 3) sums Incoming Plan qty 4) returns breakdown with available = MAX(totalStock - allocated, 0)
calculateAvailableStock.test_logic: Returns object with hasWarning status based on orderQty > available calculation

validateRowStockWarning.details: Function validates a single row, calls calculateAvailableStock, compares orderQty vs available, returns warning object. Properly handles excludeRowId parameter for edit mode by excluding that row's date from allocation.
validateRowStockWarning.test_logic: Returns { hasWarning, orderQty, availableStock, overBy, details } for all scenarios

createPlan.details: Modified to validate stock warning before insert. Checks if warning exists and stockWarningAcknowledged is false; returns error if not acknowledged. Sets metadata if acknowledged.

editPlan.details: Modified to check: if (req.body.orderQty && req.body.orderQty > (existingPlan.orderQty || 0)). Only validates stock warning on qty INCREASE. Does not warn on decrease or unchanged qty.

previewImportExcel.details: Modified to calculate stock warnings for each row and separate into d.okStockRows and d.warningStockRows arrays. Returns stockWarnings array with breakdown.

commitImportExcel.details: Modified to accept stockWarningOverrides parameter. Checks if row is in overrides map and skips non-overridden rows with warnings. Sets stockWarningAcknowledged=true for overridden rows.

importPreviousDay.details: Modified to calculate stock warnings after filtering completed rows. Returns stockWarnings array and hasStockWarnings flag in preview response.

database_schema.details: All three fields added to schema with appropriate defaults. Persists acknowledgment metadata.

AddLacquerPlan.details: State for stockWarnings and acknowledgeStockWarning implemented. Validates on blur via API call to /validate-stock. Displays warning UI. Blocks submit if warnings unacknowledged.

EditLacquerPlan.details: Similar state management as Add. Validates stock warning only when qty is increased (not decreased). Displays delta and acknowledgment checkbox.
EditLacquerPlan.test_logic: Only triggers validation if newOrderQty > currentOrderQty

ImportExcelModal.details: UI displays OK and warning rows separately with override checkboxes. Sends stockWarningOverrides map to backend on commit.
ImportExcelModal.test_logic: Only imports rows with override checkbox checked or no warning

LacquerPlan.details: Visual indicators (⚠️ badges) for rows with stockWarningAcknowledged=true. Row highlighting in yellow/orange.
LacquerPlan.test_logic: Rows with override flag display with warning badge

validateStockWarning.returns: { success: true, data: { hasWarning, orderQty, availableStock, overBy, details } }

code_review_findings.finding: ✅ PASS: Completed row exclusion uses $expr with correct comparison ($lt: ['$coatingCompletedQty', '$orderQty']). Properly excludes rows where coatingCompletedQty >= orderQty. Handles both coatingCompletedQty and deprecated coatedQty fields.
✅ PASS: Stock calculation includes TODAY boundary check (planDate: { $gte: today }). Only counts future dates from today onwards. Allocation properly includes LacquerPlans + Incoming + Reserved.

✅ PASS: validateRowStockWarning properly handles excludeRowId parameter for edit mode. When excludeRowId is provided, it fetches that row and passes its planDate to calculateAvailableStock to exclude from allocation. Prevents self-counting in edit scenario.
✅ PASS: createPlan checks warning.hasWarning && !item.stockWarningAcknowledged and returns STOCK_WARNING_REQUIRED error with full warning details and requiresAcknowledge: true flag.

✅ PASS: editPlan stock warning check is guarded by condition: if (req.body.orderQty && req.body.orderQty > (existingPlan.orderQty || 0)). Only triggers on qty increase. Decrease or unchanged qty skips validation entirely.

✅ PASS: previewImportExcel creates separate arrays d.okStockRows and d.warningStockRows. Each row in d.rows is checked and categorized. stockWarnings array built with excelRowNumber index for frontend override mapping.

✅ PASS: commitImportExcel respects stockWarningOverrides map. Rows without override flag are skipped from import. Rows with override[excelRowNumber] = true are imported with stockWarningAcknowledged metadata.
✅ PASS: importPreviousDay calculates stockWarnings array after filtering completed rows. Returns hasStockWarnings flag and array in preview response. Allows user to override before final commit.

✅ PASS: Form submission properly blocked if unacknowledgedWarnings exist. Code: const unacknowledgedWarnings = Object.keys(stockWarnings).filter(idx => !acknowledgeStockWarning[idx]); if (unacknowledgedWarnings.length > 0) { return Swal.fire(...) }
✅ PASS: stockWarningAcknowledged flag properly set in request payload: stockWarningAcknowledged: acknowledgeStockWarning[rows.indexOf(row)] || false
✅ PASS: Database schema includes stockWarningAcknowledged (Boolean, default: false), acknowledgedAt (Date, default: null), stockWarningDetails (Mixed, default: null). All properly initialized.

edge_cases_found.edge_case: Stock changes between preview and commit
edge_cases_found.description: If stock allocations change between when user sees the preview and when they click import
edge_cases_found.handling: Backend recalculates at commit time. If allocation changed significantly, second row with warning will show warning on retry.

edge_cases_found.edge_case: Multiple concurrent imports to same bottle
edge_cases_found.description: Two users importing simultaneously may both see 500 available, both import 600
edge_cases_found.handling: Recalculation at commit catches this. Second import will show warning on retry. Stock consistency maintained via database queries.

edge_cases_found.description: Old data uses coatedQty, new data uses coatingCompletedQty
edge_cases_found.handling: Completion check uses both fields: $expr { $lt: ['$coatingCompletedQty', '$orderQty'] }. Handles both via separate fields.

edge_cases_found.description: Plain bottle has 0 available stock, user tries to order even 1 unit
edge_cases_found.handling: calculateAvailableStock returns available: 0. Any orderQty > 0 triggers warning. hasWarning = true, overBy = orderQty.
